title: YRT – Touched
description:
Generate a Touched character — their social class, animal aspect, and supernatural features in the Yrt setting.

1. Roll on this table to determine class and feature count. If Pure, stop.
2. Roll on YRT – Touched Animal to determine the animal aspect.
3. For Second/Third, roll the indicated dice for the exact feature count.
4. Roll on YRT – Touched Features once per feature (re-roll duplicates).

value.description: Pure with no detectable characteristics. Cannot use Touched Assets. In Freeport interactions requiring a bond or negotiation, receive +1 on your roll.
Small animal manifestations that are concealable or correctable through surgery or magic.
Noticeable deviations with 1–3 major manifestations, diminished but not correctable through surgery or magic.
Gross, uncorrectable or non-symmetric manifestations affecting 4–6 body parts.
More beast than man, including those affected in their mind only. Features are all-encompassing — determine narratively with the player.
